claim: A physically audited ETM co-design framework for distributed vertical power delivery couples converter synthesis, rail-aware interconnect loss, a physical cooler and a convergent local solder response metric in one self-consistent loop.
permitted_wording: a physically audited framework; twenty-two falsification gates
forbidden_wording: a validated design tool; an optimizer

claim: Vertical placement of the converter changes the local solder fatigue-relevant inelastic RESPONSE by 16.3 %, and the backside architecture carries the lower response (D_driver = 1.1947).
permitted_wording: lower local fatigue-relevant inelastic response; robust ordering
forbidden_wording: less damage; longer life; Z2 outlives Z1; validated relative life

claim: Ranking architectures by package T_max is not equivalent to ranking them by the local solder response: the hotter architecture carries the lower response (+8.14 K, -16.3 %).
permitted_wording: T_max ranking is not the response ranking

claim: Global package warpage is a poor proxy for the local solder response: it tracks the direction but not the magnitude.
permitted_wording: warpage is a poor proxy for local response

claim: Rail-aware vertical current paths change intra-VR interconnect loss by orders of magnitude: a template that puts the 16 V intermediate rail across the tier boundary instead of the 1 V rail collapses its vertical loss by three orders.
permitted_wording: rail-aware path selection changes vertical loss by orders of magnitude

claim: Interconnect and assembly realizability can invalidate a numerically attractive architecture: three successive corrections (TSV range misapplied, mid-plane spans, material-layer via counting) each changed the realizability verdict without changing the response ordering.
permitted_wording: realizability can invalidate an architecture that looks best numerically

claim: A repartition of the existing components makes the 20.408 A switch node an adjacent-tier RDL transition, dropping the worst build-up aspect ratio from 5.05 to 0.83, at identical component set, per-tier area and stack height.
The number of regulators is mechanically inert over the swept range.
permitted_wording: regulator count is mechanically inert in this model

claim: The HVR footprint/mechanics opposition reported for a free package disappears once the assembly is mounted; the sign is assembly-state dependent.
permitted_wording: assembly state can reverse the sign

claim: Direct 1 V lateral delivery in the evaluated stack is prohibitively lossy; higher-voltage or vertical distribution is required.
permitted_wording: prohibitively lossy in the evaluated stack

claim: Under minimum-capability provisioning the TSV conductor cross-section cancels out of the field resistance: enlarging a via changes the COUNT and essentially nothing else.
forbidden_wording: a larger via costs more vias

claim: Absolute solder life for this package.
forbidden_wording: N cycles; qualified lifetime; meets a mission requirement
